Validate a Single GP Model's Predictions

Source: R/validation-diagnostics.R
validate_single_gp_predictions.Rd

Predicts a depth trend from group_model and measures its smoothness as one minus the normalized mean absolute second difference of the predicted curve (a roughness measure).

Usage

validate_single_gp_predictions(group_model, criteria)

Arguments

group_model

Fitted GP model.

criteria

List, optionally with test_depths (default seq(0, 150, by = 10)) and smoothness_criteria (default 0.1).

Value

List with prediction_smoothness, uncertainty_reasonable, prediction_quality.
